name: ceo-inbox-search
description: Search the principal's personal email inbox using Gmail-native query syntax. Messages filed in Spam or Trash are omitted unless include_spam_and_trash is true, whatever the query says. Pass folder: 'DRAFTS' to instead search unsent drafts by subject/recipient. Only for the ceo-inbox agent: it reads the principal's personal email.

inputs.query: string (for messages: Gmail-native search query, e.g. 'from:alice subject:invoice'. For drafts: a plain substring matched case-insensitively against subject and recipient name/email)
inputs.folder: string? (omit to search messages; pass 'DRAFTS' to search unsent drafts instead)
inputs.include_spam_and_trash: boolean? (default false; set true to include messages filed in Spam or Trash. A query such as in:spam does not opt in by itself)
inputs.modified_since: string? (DRAFTS only: ISO 8601 date-time; keep drafts changed at or after it. Resolve 'this morning' with date-resolve)
inputs.mailbox: string? (Mailbox id. Omit unless the principal named an account; Curia finds the right one.)

outputs.messages: array of { id, threadId, from, subject, date, snippet, unread, folders } (when searching messages)
outputs.drafts: array of { id, threadId, subject, to, cc, snippet, date, date_local, created_by_curia (null if unknown) } (returned instead of messages when folder is DRAFTS, alongside folder: 'DRAFTS')
outputs.next_page_token: string? (pass as page_token for the next page)
outputs.mailbox_errors: array? of { mailbox, mailbox_label, error } for failed mailboxes
